questions.question: Identify the segment which contains a grammatical error. 'Mathematics are a difficult subject.'
questions.explanation: Subjects like Mathematics, Physics, News, etc., look plural but are singular. The verb should be 'is'.

hi.question: दिए गए वाक्य के किस भाग में व्याकरणिक त्रुटि है? 'Mathematics are a difficult subject.'
hi.explanation: Mathematics, Physics जैसे विषय दिखने में plural लगते हैं लेकिन singular होते हैं। सही verb 'is' होगी।

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: COMMENCE
questions.explanation: Commence means to begin. 'Start' is the synonym.

hi.question: दिए गए शब्द का सही पर्यायवाची (Synonym) चुनें: COMMENCE
hi.explanation: Commence का अर्थ है आरंभ करना। Start का अर्थ भी शुरू करना है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The book belongs _____ me.
questions.explanation: The verb 'belong' is always followed by the preposition 'to'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: The book belongs _____ me.
hi.explanation: 'Belong' के साथ हमेशा 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Select the meaning of the idiom: 'Cost an arm and a leg'
questions.explanation: It means something is extremely expensive.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ चुनें: 'Cost an arm and a leg'
hi.explanation: इसका अर्थ है 'बहुत महंगा होना'।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: BRAVE
questions.explanation: Brave means ready to face danger. Cowardly means lacking courage.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: BRAVE
hi.explanation: Brave (बहादुर) का विलोम Cowardly (कायर) है।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Calendar' (ends with -ar).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Calendar' है।

questions.question: Improve the underlined part: If I *was* a bird, I would fly.
questions.explanation: In hypothetical or imaginary situations (Second Conditional), we use 'were' with 'I'. Correct: 'If I were a bird...'

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: If I *was* a bird, I would fly.
hi.explanation: काल्पनिक वाक्यों में 'I' के साथ हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग होता है (जैसे: काश मैं पक्षी होता)।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'Food that is fit to be eaten'
questions.explanation: Edible means suitable for eating. Potable is fit for drinking.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'Food that is fit to be eaten'
hi.explanation: खाने योग्य भोजन को Edible कहते हैं।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'Fifty kilometers are a long distance to walk.'
questions.explanation: When a plural number applies to a singular distance, amount, or time, it takes a singular verb. Correct: 'Fifty kilometers is...'

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'Fifty kilometers are a long distance to walk.'
hi.explanation: जब दूरी, समय या राशि एक इकाई के रूप में ली जाती है, तो verb singular (is) होनी चाहिए।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The boy jumped _____ the river.
questions.explanation: 'Into' suggests movement from outside to inside.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: The boy jumped _____ the river.
hi.explanation: बाहर से अंदर की ओर गति के लिए 'into' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: ACCURATE
questions.explanation: Accurate means correct in all details. Precise is the synonym.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: ACCURATE
hi.explanation: Accurate का अर्थ है सटीक। Precise का अर्थ भी सटीक है।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Tomorrow' (one m, double r).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Tomorrow' है।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'Let the cat out of the bag'
questions.explanation: It means to allow a secret to be known, usually without intending to.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ: 'Let the cat out of the bag'
hi.explanation: अनजाने में रहस्य खोल देना।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: She is *tired with* waiting for him.
questions.explanation: The correct phrase is 'tired of', meaning bored or impatient with something.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: She is *tired with* waiting for him.
hi.explanation: सही मुहावरा 'tired of' (ऊब जाना/थक जाना) है।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'Handwriting that cannot be read'
questions.explanation: Illegible means not clear enough to be read. Legible means clear.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'Handwriting that cannot be read'
hi.explanation: ऐसी लिखावट जिसे पढ़ा न जा सके, उसे Illegible (अपठनीय) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Select the antonym of: ARRIVE
questions.explanation: Arrive means to reach a place. Depart means to leave.

hi.question: विलोम शब्द चुनें: ARRIVE
hi.explanation: Arrive (आना/पहुंचना) का विलोम Depart (प्रस्थान करना) है।

questions.question: Identify the error: 'She don't know the answer.'
questions.explanation: 'She' is a singular subject (third person), so it takes 'doesn't', not 'don't'. Correct: 'She doesn't know...'

hi.question: त्रुटि ज्ञात करें: 'She don't know the answer.'
hi.explanation: 'She' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'does not' (doesn't) का प्रयोग होना चाहिए, 'don't' का नहीं।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The plane took _____ at 6 PM.
questions.explanation: 'Take off' means to become airborne.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: The plane took _____ at 6 PM.
hi.explanation: विमान के उड़ान भरने को 'Take off' कहते हैं।

questions.question: Meaning of the idiom: 'A hot potato'
questions.explanation: A hot potato is a controversial issue or situation that is awkward or unpleasant to deal with.

hi.question: मुहावरे का अर्थ: 'A hot potato'
hi.explanation: एक विवादास्पद मुद्दा जिसे कोई संभालना नहीं चाहता।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Prevent him _____ going there.
questions.explanation: 'Prevent' is followed by the preposition 'from'.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: Prevent him _____ going there.
hi.explanation: 'Prevent' (रोकना) के साथ हमेशा 'from' का प्रयोग होता है।

questions.question: One word substitution: 'One who knows everything'
questions.explanation: Omniscient means knowing everything. Omnipresent is present everywhere. Omnipotent is all-powerful.

hi.question: एक शब्द प्रतिस्थापन: 'One who knows everything'
hi.explanation: जो सब कुछ जानता हो उसे Omniscient (सर्वज्ञ) कहते हैं।

questions.question: Improve the sentence: He is the *better* of the two boys.
questions.explanation: When comparing two persons/things using 'of the two', we use 'the + comparative degree'. The sentence is correct.

hi.question: वाक्य सुधार: He is the *better* of the two boys.
hi.explanation: जब दो में से तुलना हो और 'of the two' का प्रयोग हो, तो 'the + comparative degree' (the better) सही है। कोई सुधार नहीं चाहिए।

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Successful' (double c, double s, single l at the end).

hi.question: सही वर्तनी चुनें।
hi.explanation: सही स्पेलिंग 'Successful' है।

questions.question: Select the synonym of: VACANT
questions.explanation: Vacant means not occupied; empty.

hi.question: समानार्थक शब्द चुनें: VACANT
hi.explanation: Vacant का अर्थ है खाली। Empty का अर्थ भी खाली है।

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He deals _____ sugar.
questions.explanation: 'Deal in' means to trade in something (business). 'Deal with' means to handle a person or problem.

hi.question: रिक्त स्थान भरें: He deals _____ sugar.
hi.explanation: व्यापार करने के लिए 'deal in' का प्रयोग होता है। (वह चीनी का व्यापार करता है)।
